answer: Reaching the zephyr of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Each submission hangs on the basalt of a task receipt, and the thread is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
